deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words into a specific spatial description ('alongside it') that the lecturer did not state. This description is anatomically incorrect and unsupported by the text, which indicates that the canal goes 'between' (through) the neck of the womb, rather than alongside it.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Histologically, this is the endocervical canal here, and so you're looking at the cervix here.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: and the cervix is seen alongside it.
